jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


NanoTemper makes software that runs scientific measurement instruments — used by researchers and biopharma teams to make faster, more confident decisions. The software matters: it sits between precise hardware and the scientists trying to understand complex biology.  

  

**You're role:**  

You will own product features end\-to\-end: from understanding the requirement, through implementation and testing, to release and maintenance. The current product landscape includes C\#/.NET, TypeScript, React, and Python. C\#/.NET is an important part of the existing software, while our technology choices continue to evolve with the needs of our products.  

  

**You may work across several types of software, including:**

* Control and analysis software for scientific instruments.
* Instrument backends that support measurement workflows and interact with the devices.
* Web application components that help users access and work with instrument data.


You will maintain, develop, and take ownership of software in these areas, depending on the product and your experience. You will also work at the boundary between software and hardware — collaborating with embedded engineers where the application talks directly to measurement instruments.  

This is a product engineering role. You will be writing code, reviewing it, fixing things that break in production, and improving the pipelines that ship the product.#### **Your expertise**


Required qualifications:

  

* Proven track record using C\# and .NET
* Experience with Git
* Professional experience shipping and maintaining production software, including ownership of software throughout its lifecycle
* Experience with build pipelines and release processes
* In\-depth experience in automated testing


Preferred qualifications:  

* Proficiency in TypeScript and React
* Familiarity with WPF
* Working knowledge of Python
* Hands\-on involvement in hardware or instrument integration
* A track record of developing software that interfaces with hardware or measurement devices
* Background in scientific, laboratory, or instrumentation software

#### **Why us?**

 **Who are you joining?**  

A team of 8 engineers and 1 product owner. The team has strong engineering foundations and doesn't need to relitigate architecture every sprint — you will find colleagues who want to ship good software and value a teammate who does the same. When we tackle something new, the architecture conversation is open to everyone.  

You will work closely with scientists, hardware engineers, and product managers, which means translating between technical and non\-technical perspectives is a regular part of the job.  

We work in the heart of Munich with excellent public transportation access. We work in a flexible hybrid model. We value regular in\-person collaboration, while offering the flexibility to work remotely when it makes sense.

#### **About us**


Our vision at NanoTemper is to help create a world where every disease is treatable. What drives us is partnering with scientists to ‘make a difference’ in the world.  

With our biophysical instruments we want to push the limits of what is possible for scientific researchers.  

The goals are big and audacious. Hence, it requires very innovative ways and a strong team to get there.  

  

Even if we are an expanding global company with more than 200 employees the heart of NanoTemper beats in Munich. This is where our story began and every day we work as one team to make our devices even better.  

  

Our doors are open for talented people excited about the future of scientific research and our vision.  

Do you want to make a difference with your daily work and become part of our mission? We are looking forward to get to know you.  

  

**But why not let your new colleagues tell you personally what it's like to be part of NanoTemper?**

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Cranial Navigation
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Founded in Munich, Germany in 1989, Brainlab develops, manufactures and markets software\-driven medical technology, enabling access to improved, more efficient, less\-invasive patient treatments. Our key to success is our creative, talented and hard\-working team, which consists of around 2400 dedicated and inspiring individuals in 25 locations worldwide. To succeed in reaching our targets, we are seeking committed colleagues who can stand behind our core values curious, authentic and useful.

 **Job Description**  

As a highly motivated Software Engineer in our international and highly skilled Cranial Navigation team, you will be integral part of the software development process from the very first idea until the final product launch. In this position, you will be responsible for developing image\-guided surgery applications used for Cranial surgeries used by thousands of neurosurgeons worldwide – which start from classic neurosurgical navigation applications used for tumor resection or cranial approach planning or placing navigated shunts or biopsy needles and goes through ENT surgery mainly focusing on functional endoscopic sinus surgery to CMF surgery addressing navigated implant positioning or bone reconstruction. Our applications are characterized by being highly integrated with other devices like

* Surgical microscopes creating surgical augmented reality
* Ultrasound devices creating 3D ultrasound imaging
* Brainlab’s own Robotic Arm (Cirq)
* Intraoperative CT/MR scanner integration creating up\-to\-date intraoperative images updating pre\-planned data to match the surgical situation. This may even include joint coding with our partners, which makes software development even more interesting.


As part of a multi\-disciplinary team consisting of Hardware\-, Software\- and Clinical Application Engineers, you will use your programming skills in C\+\+ and HTML5 to create software for our Cranial Navigation portfolio. By working closely with other teams and utilizing our existing software framework, you will create an application which will be used by neuro surgeons in hospitals all around the world.


As a full stack software engineer, you will

* be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining software components and software applications in C\+\+, Java Script and HTML5 (React)
* work closely together with our application engineers and implement human\-machine interface and design in cooperation with clinical \& usability experts
* work closely together with our software engineering specialists from other R\&D teams in order to design, specify and create a flexible, efficient and sustainable software architecture
* use the latest AI language models to maintain and create agents to support your productivity and to boost code quality
* have the possibility to work on different parts of our application – from user interface over 3D rendering to specialized algorithms solving typically 3D geometric problems and even further on software architecture design
* be involved in the development process from the very first idea until the final launch of the product

  

**Qualifications**  

* You have an education in Computer Science, Computer Visualization, Mathematics, Physics or a related discipline.
* You have fun with object oriented programming and C\+\+ is the programming language you command the most.
* Preferably, you are also confident with C\#, JavaScript and HTML5 or other toolkits like JavaScript React.
* Familiarity with AI models for your daily work and agents for more complex tasks is beneficial
* Ideally (but not mandatory) you have experience in the fields of medical imaging and DICOM, 3D visualization, network communication, or even robotics
* You want to be part of a high\-skilled team and make a difference with your code every day
* Fluent English, eagerness to learn German and ability to communicate with colleagues from all around the world and different areas of specialty complete your profile

  

**Additional Information**  

* A mutually\-supportive, international team
* Meaningful work with a lasting impact on medical technology
* 30 vacation days, plus December 24th and December 31st
* Bike leasing via cooperation partner "BikeLeasing"
* Parking garage and safe underground bike storage
* Award\-winning subsidized company restaurant and in\-house cafes
* Variety\-rich fitness program in our ultra\-modern 360m2 company gym
* Regular after work, team, and company events
* Comprehensive training and continuing education opportunities


Ready to apply? We look forward to receiving your online application including your first available start date and desired salary.


Contact person: Ayline Föll

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Python/Azure/Fabric/Purview)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.  

  

Your Skills And Experiences  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.
##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues


Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories

IP Routing,


TCP/IP,

Proven experience of working with MS Fabric,


AI Landing zones,

self\-driven/self\-motivated.

jobs.title: Senior Unity Developer - Core Game Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Full\-Time \| Berlin, Germany



We are Kolibri Games \- a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.


Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.


**Senior Unity Developer \- Core Game Tech (f/m/d)**
====================================================



We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer to join our Core Game Tech (CGT) Team — the small, senior team behind the technology that every Kolibri game runs on.



Our work spans consulting game teams on technical decisions, investigating problems where nobody has defined the requirements yet, and building the systems and integrations that the games depend on. That ranges from compliance features and third\-party SDKs to shared systems, standardization and keeping our engine and tooling current.



You'll work in a small specialized team alongside technical decision makers to have strong impact on all the games across our portfolio.



If you like being the person who takes on the technical problems other teams can't, and you don't shy away from constantly diving into new unknowns, learning new skills and driving topics forward, this role is for you.



**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design and build the shared systems multiple live games with dynamic events and scheduled content for millions of users run on


* Drive third\-party integrations and keep the portfolio current: evaluate and integrate SDKs, drive SDK and Unity version upgrades, and understand the impact across every game before it lands


* Advise game teams as their technical counterpart, driving standardization and winning adoption of shared solutions on the strength of the work and the argument


* Deliver compliance and privacy features across the portfolio, such as age assurance APIs, CMP implementations and GDPR data deletion flows


* Investigate open\-ended technical problems and turn regulations, vendor changes and internal needs into concrete technical requirements


**Required skills**
-------------------


* (Ideally 5\+ years of professional) Software development experience in C\# and Unity3D. Experience in non\-gaming contexts is also relevant; we value your expertise, so do not hesitate to apply


* You have a wide understanding of how Unity works, you are familiar with native implementations, understand backend interactions, and performance investigations are your bread and butter. The most important skill is to be able to jump into the unknown and get familiar


* Strong written and spoken communication, and the credibility to make teams you don't sit with want to adopt your solutions


* Experience building libraries, packages, APIs or tooling that other developers consume, and an instinct for what makes them adoptable


* Ability to plan, communicate, and execute technical solutions in a way that is both understandable for other developers as well as non technical stakeholders


* Ability to derive requirements yourself from ambiguous or external sources — regulation, platform policy, vendor documentation — rather than working from a written spec


* A genuine appetite for constantly learning new areas of the stack


**Desirable skills**
--------------------


* Experience debugging below the C\# layer into Android and iOS platform code, and profiling performance on mobile


* Exposure to compliance, privacy or platform policy work — GDPR, CMP, age assurance, ATT or similar


* Familiarity with reactive or async programming and dependency injection frameworks, e.g. UniRx, Zenject, UniTask


* A passion for games and an understanding of the mobile market, like F2P and LiveOps


* Strong familiarity with using LLMs in different areas of game development to support your efforts and achieve stronger results


* Familiarity with Firebase Crashlytics and an understanding of ANRs.


**What We Offer**
-----------------

**Hybrid Work**


We understand how important flexibility is. That's why we offer a hybrid work setup and flexible hours, allowing you to balance your time between the office and remote work

**Modern Office Space**


Our new, centrally located office in Berlin\-Mitte has everything you need to excel. We also have plenty of opportunities for fun, with table tennis and kicker tables, meeting spaces, and a sleek modern design


Take a look around

**Health \& Fitness Bonus**


We provide a monthly fitness bonus. Enjoy your time outside the office by picking the activity that suits you, from Urban Sports Club, to covering your gym membership

**Company Holidays**


We plan amazing company holidays to relax and bond as a team

**Learning Budget**


We're serious about supporting your professional growth. You'll get a yearly learning budget to spend on any form of learning that will help you develop your skills and grow in your role

**Relocation**


Moving to another country can be stressful. Our HR team will guide and support you, making sure that you (and your family) make your way to Berlin as smoothly as possible

**30 Days Holiday**


Our company implements a 30\-day yearly holiday policy for all Kolibris. This means you have plenty of time to enjoy life outside of work

**Fun Social Events**


From BBQ's and movie nights to team lunches and more. We also have a team event budget you can use to buy games or sports equipment to make working here even more fun. On Fridays after work, there's dinner and drinks waiting for everyone at the office



Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.


We are an international studio, so don’t forget to send in your application in English. Although it is not mandatory, we always appreciate a cover letter stating your motivation to join us.


We look forward to hearing from you!

Sandbox Interactive is the ambitious game development studio behind the award\-winning game Albion Online. The game is the first true cross\-platform MMO, and is playable on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android with more than 350\.000 daily players and over 2 million monthly visitors on our website. We started as a small independent group of experienced gaming professionals in 2012, and now employ an international team of more than 100 people. Since 2020, Sandbox Interactive has been part of the Stillfront Group. Our team is passionate about making Albion Online the best game it can be, and we’re constantly on the lookout for talented individuals to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

### **Your Game**


As a Senior Server Developer, you will help design, develop, and maintain the systems that keep Albion Online world running smoothly. You’ll work on backend features and services that support millions of players, ensuring stability, scalability and performance across a continuously evolving live environment.


This role requires deep technical expertise, a proactive mindset and a passion for large\-scale online systems. You’ll collaborate closely with game developers and designers to deliver reliable tools, features and infrastructure that enhance the gameplay experience and support ongoing content updates.

* Architect and maintain high\-throughput backend systems that power Albion Online’s large\-scale, persistent world

#### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in backend or network programming for online or multiplayer games.
* Strong proficiency in C\# and experience with the Unity engine

* Solid understanding of database systems (SQL/NoSQL), cloud environments and distributed server infrastructure
* Experience with performance optimization, debugging, and profiling in large\-scale systems

#### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on MMORPGs or sandbox games

jobs.title: Cloud & Security Architect (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Better Futures with the Power of Light
  
We create photonic solutions to shape the world of tomorrow, together with people who embrace brilliant ideas with openness and curiosity. With teams in over 80 countries, we offer you the opportunity to reach your full potential.
  
  

Cloud \& Security Architect (w/m/d)
  
**Job ID:** 5288
  
  

**Location:**  

Monheim, North Rhine\-Westphalia, DE
  
  

**Date:** Sep 15, 2026
  
  

**Job Description:**  

We are seeking an experienced Cloud \& Security Architect to join our team and lead the architecture, resilience, and security posture of our enterprise application platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Azure Cloud Architecture, Security Engineering, and Modern Application Development.Our application suite is built with C\# and .NET and is deployed across a hybrid environment spanning Microsoft Azure, On\-Premises infrastructure, and Docker / Kubernetes (K8s). Because our application is exposed directly to the public internet, ensuring robust security \- ranging from edge defense and zero\-trust networking to secure coding practices and container hardening \- is at the core of this role.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

**DevSecOps Culture \& Mentorship:**  

Drive and cultivate a security\-first and DevOps\-oriented culture across software engineering and infrastructure teams
  
Lead hands\-on workshops, establish security excellence programs, and mentor developers on secure coding and automated operational practices
  
  

**Public Internet Security \& Perimeter Defense:**  

Design and enforce edge protection strategies (Azure Front Door, WAF, Application Gateway, DDoS Protection) for all internet\-facing APIs and services
  
Enforce Zero\-Trust Network Architecture, strict IP/GEO filtering, rate\-limiting, and modern API security protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS)
  
  

**DevOps \& CI/CD Security Governance:**  

Architect, standardize, and help maintain secure CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)Own automated Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment workflows
  
Embed continuous security gates (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into the build and release lifecycle
  
  

**Azure \& Hybrid Cloud Architecture:**  

Architect and maintain cloud infrastructure in Azure aligned with cloud security best practices and the Microsoft Well\-Architected Framework
  
Design secure hybrid connectivity between Azure, on\-premises data centers, and containerized environments using Azure Arc, ExpressRoute, and VPN gateways
  
  

**Container \& Kubernetes Security:**  

Define and enforce security controls across containerized workloads (Docker, AKS, and On\-Prem Kubernetes)
  
Implement pod security standards, network policies (Calico/Cilium), image scanning, and container runtime threat detection
  
  

**Security Operations \& Governance Execution:**  

Coordinate and execute recurring security governance best practices, including regular user access reviews (IAM/PIM audits), cloud application security assessments, penetration testing, and automated policy compliance across all hybrid environments
  
  

**Technical Requirements Ownership \& Documentation:**  

Take ownership of translating technologically\-heavy business and product goals into detailed technical requirement specifications, system design docs, and architectural decision records (ADRs)
  
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and Developers to define, document, and manage technical user stories and acceptance criteria
  
  

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**  

**Education:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field required (as the baseline requirement)
  
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Information Technology strongly recommended
  
  

**Work Experience:** 7\+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Cybersecurity, and/or DevSecOps roles
  
  

**Execution \& Drive:** Self\-motivated, hands\-on practitioner with a "doer" mentality, taking strong personal ownership and pride in the quality, security, and elegance of technical deliverables
  
  

**Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire engineering teams to continuously raise the bar and strive for excellence
  
  

**Public Internet Exposure:** Hands\-on experience defending public\-facing, internet\-exposed applications against threats (e.g., volumetric DDoS, credential stuffing, API abuse, SQLi)
  
  

**Azure Technical Stack:** Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and security tools (Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints)
  
  

**DevOps Architecture \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Experience in driving automated infrastructure provisioning, continuous deployment, and telemetry across hybrid Azure, on\-premises, and Kubernetes environments, ensuring zero\-downtime deployments, high availability, and operational resilience
  
  

**Software \& Distributed Architecture Expertise:** Strong background in software architecture with proven experience designing and securing microservices architectures. Solid understanding of distributed systems, event\-driven messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus), data persistence patterns, and API gateway integrations
  
  

Certifications (Associate \& Expert level welcome)
  
  

**Microsoft Azure Associate Certifications (Preferred/Targeted):** Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\), Azure Developer Associate (AZ\-204\), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ\-700\)
  
**Expert / Industry Certifications (A plus):** Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) or CISSP
  
  

**Contact:**  

**Name:** Sophie Krug
  
  

**E\-Mail:** recruiting@jenoptik.com
  
  

**What we offer:**  

About Jenoptik
  
  

With its Strategic Business Unit (SBU) Smart Mobility Solutions, Jenoptik provides photonics\-based, innovative and sustainable solutions, including technology and services for road safety and security. As an end\-to\-end solution provider, we support our customers with the provision of roadside equipment and software, including integration, installation, maintenance and financing models through to full\-service operation of our solutions. Our strong global presence and installation base is supported by a longstanding partner network with tens of thousands systems deployed worldwide. Leveraging 90 years of experience and 40 years in ANPR, Jenoptik is a world\-leading enabler for road safety and civil security, with intelligent solutions and services constantly evolving to help make roads, journeys, communities and our environment safer around the globe.
  
  

Have we made you interested in this position?
  
  

If so, we look forward to receiving your online application.
  
  

Should you need any further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Come and build innovative services that protect our cloud from advanced security threats!  

  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that!  

  

We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will leverage Amazon technology (Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, etc.) to solve AWS Security problems at staggering scale. You will raise the bar on our software architecture and development practices. You will share ownership of our operational excellence, ensuring our system is properly tuned and has appropriate alarms for warning or error conditions. You will help drive our working backwards processes, inventing and simplifying on behalf of our customers. You will build security detections that identify specific security issues and automatically help customers reduce their risk through network and security controls.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. You will also have specific on\-call responsibilities to support the European Sovereign Cloud. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.  

  

A day in the life  

* Collaborate with data scientists and security engineers to build automated security detection and mitigation workflows
* Design scalable architectures for low\-latency, big data processing
* Improve the observability, performance, and efficiency of our existing systems
* Raise the bar for testing, repeatability, automation, and operational excellence
* Mentor and develop teammates, both technically and professionally
* Seek out, develop, and advocate for new technologies

  

About the team  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. **Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400\+ car /car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmissions Offshore Portfolio of works, we have an opportunity for a Substation Project Engineer to join our Offshore AC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our Island projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our Island projects facilitate the connection to our HVDC systems and include state\-of the\-art AC plant, grid control and stabilisation technology.


**You will**


* Create outline scope, site location plans, primary plant/ substation layout and Single Line Diagrams for new build and asset replacement type projects, operating up to 400kV.


* Review contractor/consultants detailed designs and witness Factory Acceptance Tests.


* Implement safety by design principles to ensure that engineering and safety risks are adequately controlled.


* Support site and operational teams to ensure the quality of installations, with minimal risk to Network security.


* Evaluate tenders and procure and manage specialist services from consultants.


**You have**


* Experience in transmission level substation projects, document review, factory acceptance testing, installation and commissioning ideally up to 400kV including AIS and GIS, and be comfortable to technically assess issues and critically assess a range of technical solutions.


* An understanding of the legislation and implications for the Transmission network management for both Assets and Projects, including Construction Design Management \& Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations.


* A problem solving attitude with the strength of character to ensure critical matters are addressed by the project teams.


* Enthusiasm combined with excellent communication skills, with the ability to demonstrate diligence and prioritise tasks.


* A degree or HND in Electrical Engineering or relevant technical experience and ideally be a Chartered Engineer or working towards professional accreditation with a relevant institution.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Hannah.E.Cutajar@sse.com / \+44 (0\) 1738 341147 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
West Malling, Kent
  
As an **IT Infrastructure Engineer** at Cabot Credit Management, you will play a key role in delivering and supporting robust, secure, and scalable technology services across our organisation. With a primary focus on UK operations and an awareness of wider European business needs, you’ll take a hands\-on approach to infrastructure support, system administration, and project delivery.


Operating within our IT Operations team, you’ll provide expert 3rd line support and technical leadership across a diverse technology landscape \- proactively troubleshooting, optimising systems, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure our IT services remain reliable, resilient, and fit for the future.


**What you can expect as an Infrastructure Engineer:**


* Permanent
* Hybrid role from our Kings Hill office, Kent. ME19 4UA.

Not only are we offering a competitive salary and a fantastic bonus scheme, you’ll also be entitled to loads of great benefits including, discount and cash back on hundreds of high\-street shops and private health insurance, plus much more.


**Key responsibilities include:**


* Ensure high availability, reliability, and security are embedded across infrastructure and service delivery.
* Lead vulnerability management, patching, and preventative maintenance across platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and 3rd line support, resolving complex and high\-impact incidents.
* Review, validate, and contribute to infrastructure design and project delivery.
* Support IT governance, compliance, and audits (including SOX, PCI\-DSS), ensuring adherence to controls and regulations.
* Operate within ITIL frameworks, managing incidents, problems, and changes effectively.
* Plan and execute disaster recovery testing to ensure business continuity.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise systems to maintain performance and integrity.
* Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors to deliver and support services.
* Integrate security and best practice into all technology and lifecycle decisions.
* Support ongoing system administration, service improvements, and out\-of\-hours escalation where required.

**We are looking for someone with:**

**Essential:**


* Expert level NetApp Ontap and AFF skills
* Strong expertise in Windows Server platforms.
* Experience with VMware and Microsoft AVD
* Microsoft Exchange (2016/2019 Hybrid), Office 365, and PowerShell scripting.
* Dell Server Hardware knowledge
* Veeam Backup and Replication
* Web technologies (IIS, .NET).
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DFS, DHCP, WINS.
* Windows/SQL clustering.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management.

**Desirable:**


* Azure administration (servers, storage, networking).
* Office 365 support (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint).
* Intune device management.
* Security tools (CrowdStrike, Rapid7\).
* Experience in financial services environments.
* Monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG).
* Azure Entra administration.
* Ivanti patching and deployment.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* MCSE, VCP, VMCE, NCDA

**What happens next?**

If this sounds like you and you’d like to join our rapidly expanding company that offers excellent career progression, then apply now!


**Working for Cabot:**


You’ll be working for an award winning; Investors in People Gold accredited organisation. We’re passionate about the ethical treatment of our customers and employees. Our mission is to create pathways to economic freedom. Our vision is to make credit accessible by partnering with our consumers to restore their financial health.


**Diversity and inclusion** are very important to us at Cabot, and we value a multitude of diverse talent within our business. We want everyone to be themselves at work and encourage a culture that includes everyone. Our policies ensure that every candidate and employee are treated fairly and with equal opportunities.


*\*\*At Cabot we are highly regulated by our clients, as such, any successful candidates will have to undergo a basic credit check and criminal background check. Please note that we are unable to proceed to interview stage if a CCJ, IVA or Bankruptcy appears on a credit file, or if you do not have full right to work in the UK – we are unfortunately unable to offer sponsorship.*


  
**We are people helping people**
--------------------------------


At Cabot, we’re people helping people. Supporting customers, empowering colleagues, and making the effort to be invovled in the communities we work in.


**Our Total Rewards Package for All Round Wellbeing**
-----------------------------------------------------


We understand the importance of the balance between work and life, between fun and professionalism, and between being a corporation and being a community. That’s why we provide compensation structures and benefit plans tailored to each of our global hubs, and then enhance them with a wide range of programs that support your personal and professional growth. It’s our way of showing you that we recognize your value, understand what’s important to you, and want to reward your contributions.


* ### **Holistic Wellness**


Colleague Wellness \- We're focused on your wellbeing and that means supporting you across all elements of it. This comes from our company sponsored team building events, on site events to form bonds with colleagues, Mental Health First Aid support, Webinars, Employee Assistance Program and more!
* ### **Healthcare**


Healthcare \- Take advantage of our healthcare options to help you stay well... Gym discounts, Eye Tests and discount offers on glasses, our Employee Assistance Programme and more.
* ### **Perks**


Perks \- Our Colleague Discount Programme includes Transport, Retail discounts and much more.
* ### **Career Path \& Development**


Career Progression comes from the fact we invest in our people's skills and ability. We support your individual development, offering regular training to ensure you have the best tools and knowledge for the job. We want to help you be ready for your next career move with us.
* ### **Awards \& Recognition**


Awards \& Recognition \- We will always recognise our people's contribution to what we achieve every day. That might be an informal on the spot reward or thank you or part of the formal awards and recognition we run throughout the year such as star of the month and our global President's Club.
* ### **Pay \& Bonuses**


Pay \& Bonuses \- Earn a competitive salary, with the opportunity to participate in fun team building incentives!
**Our Values In Action**
------------------------


At Cabot, we care about making a meaningful impact on our people, our customers, and our communities. We believe diversity in all its forms brings different thinking styles and perspectives. That builds our creativity and ability to find a better way. It also enables us to understand the different communities that make up our society. The more we understand, the easier it is to deliver the right outcomes for our customers.


**Inclusive Workplace**
-----------------------


We are striving to be an inclusive and progressive organisation where everyone feels comfortable and enabled to be themselves at work. We value the diversity of thought that different backgrounds and cultures can bring as it makes us stronger. The more we understand each other, the easier it is to deliver the right outcomes for our consumers and to support each other. Prioritising inclusion and belonging improves collaboration and enhances people’s wellbeing; both of which are essential parts of supporting our colleagues, and in turn our business, to succeed.


**Giving Back To Our Community**
--------------------------------


We give back by volunteering, and charity work, trying to make a positive impact on the communities, where we live and work and we are proud to do so.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Build technology that makes road inspections faster, safer and smarter. Grow your development skills in a small product team, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

**About SmartVision**

SmartVision is reimagining highway inspections with AI. Our platform brings together computer\-vision analysis, geospatial mapping and inspection management, turning road images into practical intelligence that helps teams understand road condition, prioritise maintenance and confirm repairs.

We are building SmartVision as a focused, growing company with a small team and an ambitious product. That means less distance between an idea and its impact — and plenty of scope for the right developer to help shape how we work and what we build next.

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for a curious and motivated Junior Software Developer who is ready to build their skills by solving real product problems. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll help design, build and improve applications across our .NET, SQL and React stack, while also gaining experience with Python and Azure\-hosted components.

This role will suit someone who enjoys learning, asks thoughtful questions and is comfortable in a startup\-style environment where priorities can evolve. You’ll receive guidance and support, while being encouraged to contribute ideas, take increasing responsibility and become a well\-rounded developer as SmartVision grows.

**What you’ll do**

* Help design and develop robust, maintainable applications using .NET, SQL and React.
* Learn how to turn product and customer needs into well\-considered technical solutions.
* Contribute to Azure\-hosted components using Python, object storage and event queues.
* Work with product, test and development colleagues to deliver valuable features.
* Maintain and improve existing applications through updates, refactoring and enhancements.
* Learn to estimate work, communicate progress and raise questions or risks early.
* Test your work thoroughly and build your understanding of reliability, security and performance.
* Investigate and resolve issues with support from the wider team.
* Contribute ideas in team and project discussions and learn from code reviews and feedback.
* Develop your technical knowledge and share what you learn with colleagues.

**What we’re looking for**

* A foundation in C\#/.NET and SQL, gained through study, a bootcamp, personal projects, a placement, an internship or your first development role.
* Some experience with React, or a comparable modern framework such as Angular or Vue.
* Awareness of Microsoft Azure, Python, object storage and event queues, together with an interest in developing your practical experience with these technologies.
* A basic understanding of Git and version\-control workflows.
* An understanding of testing, debugging and the importance of clear, maintainable code.
* Clear communication, attention to detail and a willingness to ask questions and act on feedback.
* Comfort working collaboratively in a small team and adapting as priorities change.
* Curiosity about the product, its users and the real\-world problems the technology is solving.

**Useful, but not essential**

* Commercial experience gained through an internship, placement or first software\-development role.
* Experience with geospatial applications, mapping or Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
* Experience building event\-driven, data\-rich, image\-based or AI\-enabled applications.
* Experience with Visual Studio or the wider Microsoft development ecosystem.

**What you’ll get**

* Visible impact: work on a product that turns complex road data into decisions people can act on.
* Supported development: learn from experienced colleagues through guidance, feedback and code reviews.
* Growing responsibility: take on broader and more complex work as your confidence develops.
* A close\-knit team: collaborate directly with the people shaping and delivering the product.
* Room to grow: develop with the company as SmartVision establishes itself and expands.
* Company benefits such as 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays and a day off for your birthday, and the Bike2Work Scheme.

**How to apply**

Apply through Tech Talent Champions via https://techtalentchampions.com/opportunities using the form on the page.

Include your CV and a short note explaining why SmartVision interests you.

Pay: £26,000\.00\-£32,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer
jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer**Locations: CT, ME**


Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?


At Utilita, we're growing our award\-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest\-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.


What is in it for you?


You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:


* **On\-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on\-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry\-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25\.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita\-sponsored arenas and football matches.


Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**


We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.


You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.


We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First\-class training and support.**


Your journey will begin at our award\-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.


You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**


We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.


Through regular manager check\-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.


What you will be doing.


As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.


You will play an important role in delivering our customer\-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**


To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.


Who are Utilita?


Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.


As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick\-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.


We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030\. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.


Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**

jobs.description:
**Job Title :** Assistant Civil Engineer

**Location:** Port of Tilbury

**Salary:** £45,000 \- £48,000

**About Forth Ports**


Forth Ports is one of the UK's largest and most dynamic port operator groups, playing a key role in connecting the UK with Europe and beyond. As a multimodal ports owner and operator, we are at the forefront of delivering innovative port\-related services.


With our recent pledge to achieve carbon neutrality by 2032 and Net Zero status by 2042, we are committed to sustainability and driving the expansion of the UK's renewable energy sector, particularly offshore wind. Now is an exciting time to join our team as we embark on this transformative journey towards a greener future.

**About The Role**

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS \- Please ensure you meet these before applying:**

* Unrestricted right to work in the UK (we do not offer visa sponsorship)
* Civil Engineering degree (BEng/MEng) or equivalent
* 2\-3 years post graduate UK construction/civil engineering experience
* Full UK driving licence

**About the Role**


This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious civil engineer technician at the beginning of your career to accelerate your skills within a complex, operational port environment. You'll work on diverse infrastructure projects ranging from quayside structures and pavements to drainage systems and utilities \- all within a live, 24/7 operational setting that presents unique engineering challenges.


As a Civil Engineering Technician, you'll take genuine ownership of projects from inception through to completion, supported by our experienced Engineering leadership team. This isn't a graduate training scheme \- you'll be managing real projects with budgets, programmes, and contractor interfaces from day one.

**Typical projects include:**

* Quayside and marine structure repairs and upgrades
* Internal road and pavement reconstruction \& repair programmes
* Drainage and utilities infrastructure works
* Structural inspections and remedial works
* Port estate development projects supporting operational growth

**This role requires regular site presence across the Port of Tilbury estate. Due to the operational nature of the port environment, regular remote working is not available. You must be within commutable distance of Tilbury.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Delivery**

* Take ownership of civil engineering projects from feasibility through to practical completion
* Manage project programmes, budgets (typically £50k \- £500k)
* Coordinate with operational teams to schedule works around 24/7 port activities

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Produce and update technical drawings using AutoCAD
* Develop scopes of works and review contractor designs and method statements
* Apply engineering principles to solve practical problems in a live operational environment

**CDM and Safety Compliance**

* Act as Client representative under CDM 2015 regulations
* Ensure contractors comply with port safety requirements and permit\-to\-work systems

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Experience and Qualifications:**

* BEng or MEng in Civil Engineering(or closely related discipline)
* 2\-3 years UK construction or civil engineering project experience working with contractors on site
* AutoCAD proficiency\- able to produce and modify civil engineering drawings
* Full UK driving licence \- site travel is a daily requirement

**Essential Skills:**

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities
* Practical problem\-solving approach \- able to make decisions on site
* Comfortable working independently whilst knowing when to escalate

**What Forth Ports Can Offer You**


At Forth Ports, our people are our priority, and we are committed to creating a flexible, open, and supportive working culture. As part of our team, you will enjoy:

* 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* Defined pension scheme and life assurance
* Professional membership subscriptions paid (ICE, IStructE, etc.)
* Health promotion events and employee wellbeing initiatives
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family
* Cycle to work scheme
* Attractive family\-friendly policies
* Employee discount platform offering discounts on UK\-wide restaurants, car rentals, and holidays
* GymFlex health club memberships


We value diversity and inclusivity, and we are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant and recognise the value serving personnel, veterans, reservists, and military families bring to our organisation.


As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant, we are committed to ensuring that members of the Armed Forces community are treated fairly and are not disadvantaged in their civilian careers because of their service.


We welcome applications from veterans, reservists, cadet force adult volunteers, and military spouses/partners, and we actively support flexible and inclusive recruitment practices.

 **How to Apply**


If you're a motivated civil engineer with 2\-3 years UK experience looking to develop your career in the port and infrastructure sector, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV highlighting relevant UK project experience

**Apply via the 'Apply Now' link.**

*Applications from candidates without UK work authorisation or relevant UK experience will not be progressed.*

**Required Criteria**

* Civil Engineering degree (BEng/MEng) or equivalent
* 2\-3 years post graduate UK construction/civil engineering experience
* Full UK driving licence

 **About The Company**


Over our 50 years of experience we have witnessed our ports grow to become important assets to support and deliver growth both for the UK and local economies.


The growth impact has been achieved due to the continued investments in our infrastructure, making sure that our ports are able to continually develop their services and support the growth of many industries.


Our people have played a significant role. They have delivered the highest quality of service through their expertise, loyalty and flexibility and, without them, we could not have built the strong reputation and the long term agreements with many customers that we have today.

**Company Culture**


Welcome to Forth Ports Careers. As a leading port operator, we employ over 1,100 people across our ports in Scotland and the Port of Tilbury in London.


A career in a port business is very rewarding. There is real variety within each role and significant opportunities for promotion and career development. Don’t just take our word for it; view the “Some of our People” section and the video below to gain insight into the kinds of jobs our employees do, how they’ve grown with us, and what motivates them each day.


The port business can be seen as a barometer for the economy and this drives us to be adaptable and fast paced as we identify new business opportunities.

**Company Benefits**


We are committed to creating a positive working culture for all employees, as well as a good work\-life balance.


Here are just some of the benefits of working for Forth Ports.


Vacation, Paid time off, Paid sick days, Retirement plan and/or pension, Employee discounts, Gym membership or wellness programs, Cycle to work, Competitive salary, Employee Assistance Scheme

**Salary**


£45,000\.00 \- £48,000\.00 per year

**Job Title:** Engineering Technician (Electrical)

**Location:** Port of Tilbury

**Hours:** 40 hours per week (Alternate shifts of 0600 to 1400 Monday to Friday, 1400 to 2200 Monday to Friday, 2200 to 0600 Sunday to Thursday)

**Compensation:** £57,190 \+ £5,254 Shift Allowance

  

At Forth Ports, we keep trade, logistics, and infrastructure moving. Every day, our teams support the flow of goods, materials, and services that businesses and communities rely on, helping to power economic growth across the UK and beyond. Our people are at the core of everything we do, and their expertise, commitment, and innovation drive our success.


With our commitment to reach carbon neutrality by 2032 and Net Zero by 2042, we're investing heavily in sustainable and digital technologies, including major growth in offshore wind and greener port operations. For you, this means joining a business that's evolving, ambitious, and making a real difference.

**About The Role**


The Port of Tilbury Grain Terminal is the UK’s largest grain handling facility for both imports and exports, operating to food\-grade standards through a state\-of\-the\-art, fully automated and highly flexible terminal. As an Engineering Technician, you will play a vital role in carrying out planned and reactive maintenance across plant, equipment and engineering systems, responding promptly to faults and breakdowns and helping ensure the Grain Terminal continues to operate safely, efficiently and reliably.

 **Key responsibilities:**

* Perform planned maintenance, breakdown repairs and condition monitoring activities across plant and equipment.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of terminal plant and equipment to support efficient repairs and minimise downtime.
* Carry out installations, improvements and modifications to new and existing plant, systems and equipment.
* Promptly report any damage, misuse or operational concerns relating to plant and equipment to Engineering or Operational Managers.
* Undertake ancillary tasks such as fuelling, lubrication and cleaning when required to support uninterrupted operations.
* Communicate clearly with team members, Supervisors and Managers to provide updates on plant status, repairs and breakdown activity.
* Prepare engineering reports and complete required documentation, including statutory check records where appropriate.
* Follow all written and verbal instructions, including radio communications, from Engineering Supervisors and Managers.
* Work flexibly across workshops and operational areas while maintaining compliance with company and statutory requirements.

 **What we're looking for:**

  

We are looking for a practical, safety\-focused Engineering Technician with strong electrical and mechanical maintenance experience in an industrial environment. You will be confident fault\-finding on fixed plant and equipment, comfortable working as part of a collaborative engineering team, and flexible in supporting a rotational shift pattern, including weekends. Experience in grain, port, food\-grade or similar operational environments would be beneficial.

* HNC/HND or NVQ Level 3 in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar, with 2–3 years’ maintenance experience.
* Strong working knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including PLCs, automation, hydraulics and pneumatics.

* Knowledge of health and safety, environmental standards, quality management and food safety regulations.
* Experience operating heavy plant and mobile platforms within a port or industrial environment.
* Prior shift working experience, with flexibility to work a rotational shift pattern including weekends.
* Experience with DSEAR and ATEX regulations, and COMPEX EX05/EX06 qualifications, would be desirable but are not essential as training will be provided.
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, team\-oriented approach.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Full Driving Licence, valid in the UK
* Full UK Working Rights

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**IONETIC – who are we?**



IONETIC is a battery technology start\-up based in Brackley, just a few miles from Silverstone—the heart of British motorsport. We specialise in battery pack solutions for low\-volume electrified applications, including buses, sports cars, and other vehicles. Our mission is to make electrification both possible and compelling for every vehicle OEM, by providing tailored, cost\-effective battery packs with unmatched speed and flexibility.



By integrating proprietary software, mechanical design, and manufacturing technologies into a single technology stack we call Arc, we deliver custom battery systems that meet a wide range of energy, power, and lifecycle requirements. Our chemistry\-agnostic, scalable designs are built to accelerate the journey to net zero for our customers.

 **Working at IONETIC**



IONETIC offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast\-moving, innovative start\-up that is shaping the future of electric mobility. With a strong order pipeline and growing demand for our technology, we're expanding our team to broaden our capabilities and scale our operations.



As an early\-stage employee, you will play a key role in developing the foundational technologies and capabilities that will power the next generation of electric vehicles. Every employee at IONETIC takes on meaningful responsibility and is encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative, and grow both professionally and personally in a supportive, collaborative environment.

 **Opportunity**



We are looking for a Software Engineer to build, deploy, and maintain IONETIC's internal software toolchain. jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Staff Engineer – senior individual contributor (no line management)

**Company**

Landmark Systems Ltd

**Location**

Pulborough, West Sussex/(Hybrid \- 2\-3 days on\-site

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Salary**

Dependent on experience, circa £65\-£75K

**About Landmark Systems**

Landmark Systems has been providing specialist accounting and business management software to UK farmers for over 39 years. Our KEYPrime desktop software is trusted by thousands of farms across the country. We’re rebuilding years of hard\-won agricultural domain knowledge as a modern, cloud\-native SaaS product, and we’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help us get the big technical decisions right.

**The Opportunity**

Our next\-generation product is cloud\-native, not cloud\-ported. That means genuinely interesting problems, not a lift\-and\-shift:

· **Multi\-tenancy done properly** — from single farms to multi\-entity groups, accountancy practices and resellers. How we model tenants, organisations and licenses is a live architectural question, and you’d help answer it.

· **A model\-driven platform** — much of the product is generated from a declarative metadata layer that produces both the .NET back end and the Vue front end. Knowing when to work with that grain and when to build a bespoke escape hatch is a real craft.

· **AI as a first\-class capability** — our platform ships with semantic search, retrieval and agent tooling built in. We expect our engineers to build with AI, and to build AI\-backed features into the product itself.

· **A long, deliberate migration** — moving a loyal, established customer base from a mature desktop product to the cloud, without breaking the trust that took 25 years to earn.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the hard technical decisions end to end — multi\-tenancy, data modelling, platform trade\-offs.

· Set the technical direction on the problems that matter most and bring the rest of the team with you.

· Elevate the performance of those around you : coaching senior engineers, strengthening how we design, review and ship.

· Lead the solution architecture conversations — bringing engineering, product and domain experts into the room and guiding them to decisions everyone trusts.

· Work pragmatically inside a vendor platform we don’t fully control — pushing it where it helps, working around it where it doesn’t.

· Be the person who gets to the bottom of the hard problems — the intermittent, cross\-layer, “nobody knows why” bugs that span generated code, data, tenancy and infrastructure.

· Build AI\-native workflows into both how we engineer and what our customers use.

**Essential Requirements**

· 5\+ years of senior web engineering leadership — setting technical direction and owning decisions on web/SaaS products — though we care far more about the calibre of your judgement than the number on your CV.

· Deep, current full\-stack experience across **.NET / C\#** and a modern front\-end framework with **TypeScript** — React, Angular or Vue. We build on Vue 3, but strong React or Angular engineers are just as welcome.

· A track record of **owning consequential architecture decisions under ambiguity** — and being right often enough to be trusted with the next one.

· Real experience of **multi\-tenant SaaS** and **cloud\-native delivery** on Azure (containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

· Exceptional **debugging and troubleshooting** instincts — you can reason from symptom to root cause across an unfamiliar, layered system.

· **Drive and initiative** — you move toward the hard problems and step up without being asked, motivated by shipping things customers value.

· The judgement to know **when** ***not*** **to engineer** — you build the right\-sized solution, resist gold\-plating, and ship rather than polish.

· **AI\-native engineering** — you already build with AI tooling, and you can design LLM\-backed product features (retrieval, semantic search, agents).

· The judgement and influence of someone who lifts a team rather than just out\-codes it — a natural coach who leads solution architecture discussions and brings people with them.

· Comfort evolving an established product toward cloud\-native without losing what makes it valuable.

**Our stack**

.NET / C\# · Vue 3 · TypeScript · Vite · Pinia · PostgreSQL · multi\-tenant SaaS · Azure · Kubernetes · Azure DevOps · real\-time messaging · a built\-in AI stack (semantic search, retrieval, agents).

**Why join us**

· Real problems and real ownership — you’ll shape the solution architecture.

· A rare mix: an established, profitable business with a genuine build\-from\-scratch product mission.

· A small, capable team where a Staff Engineer’s judgement carries real weight.

· Backing from a larger European agricultural software group.

· Hybrid working from our Pulborough

**What We Offer**

* The chance to shape a product used by thousands of UK farmers
* Investment in your development
* Yearly Performance bonus/Share of the Profits (if business delivers on profit)
* Hybrid working — 2\-3 days per week in our Pulborough office/home working
* Holiday allowance to include "birthday holiday" and office closure during Xmas period
* Pension scheme (5% employer contribution after qualifying period)
* Death in service
* Enhanced sick pay
* Private Health Insurance
* Company Events
* Nice office environment, casual dress code
* Free on\-site parking, near train station

**Landmark Systems Ltd** is an equal opportunities employer.

Pay: £65,000\.00\-£75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Enhanced maternity leave
* Free parking
* Paid volunteer time
* Private medical insurance
* Profit sharing
* Sick pay

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pulborough RH20 1RL

jobs.description:
Are you a pragmatic SaaS engineer who thrives on building data pipelines that turn raw data into insights that prevent real\-world infrastructure failures? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.

  

As our new **Senior Product Development Engineer**, you will be designing and developing cloud\-based analytics framework components that process diverse data sources into actionable insights — from data import and cleansing through calculation pipelines to dashboards that predict critical events such as sewage overflows in pump and pipe systems.

 **What you will be doing**


As a key part of the Analytics Platform Engineering team, you'll create impact by building the intelligent analytics framework that empowers utilities worldwide to prevent infrastructure failures before they happen, protecting communities and the environment.

  

Your main responsibilities include:

  

* Architect and develop framework components and calculation pipelines for our cloud\-based analytics product (MAP platform)
* Implement data import, cleansing, and processing workflows that transform third\-party and internal data into meaningful insights
* Resolve production bugs and work through the engineering backlog to improve platform reliability and performance
* Build and maintain predictive analytics features such as overflow alerts for sewage pumps and pipes
* Contribute architectural decisions that ensure the platform scales reliably in a real cloud environment

 **What makes you a great fit**

  

Above all, you are a hands\-on, pragmatic cloud software engineer with real\-world experience shipping and maintaining production systems — someone who has been through release cycles, handled upgrades, responded to customer feedback, and knows what it takes to get the job done. **You have experience building, enhancing, and supporting applications in a .NET environment.**

  

We would also imagine that you have:

  

* 7\+ years of experience in software product development with cloud\-based systems (design, build, deploy, and maintain)
* Strong skills in building data processing pipelines — including data import, transformation, cleansing, and calculation workflows
* Demonstrated experience with architectural design of scalable framework components in a production environment
* Proven ability to work autonomously in small agile/scrum teams and deliver iterative releases

  

It is a plus if you also have

  

* Experience with analytics or IoT platforms, particularly in utilities, water management, or industrial domains
* Familiarity with dashboard development and alert/notification systems
* Background working with third\-party data integrations and building extensible framework products

 **Why you will love working here**

  

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.

  

We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't.

 **Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!**


To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com
