jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Group Overview**

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.


Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.


Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.


The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy \& Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all\-to\-all trading platform.


The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.


**Role Overview**

TP ICAP has undertaken an ambitious program of modernization and Engineering maturity over the next three years. The program is global and across all divisions and applications. There is a desire to move towards faster, safer and more automated product delivery at scale. A key part of this program is to deliver automated CI/CD pipelines, increase developer productivity, shift left many of the traditional practices and deliver more change into production more reliably.


The candidate will be leading this uplift and modernization of engineering capabilities around automation of development, testing and production delivery for TP ICAPs platforms. The candidate will provide hands\-on as well as thought leadership in designing this strategy as well as executing with a combination of internal and external teams over the next two years. The candidate is able to educate and influence application development teams globally to adopt new tools and practices, and also demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity, time to market and operational resiliency.


The role requires a business minded, highly collaborative, team\-focussed experienced DevOps engineer with exceptional communication skills to work with developers and testers in DevOps principles.


**Role Responsibilities**

* Design DevOps modernization and adoption strategy incorporating current industry practices and technologies
* Engineer internal tooling to implement automation in software development, testing and production delivery
* Reduce manual overhead involved in software releases by fully automating delivery pipelines that includes testing
* Improve production stability and resiliency through process improvement and adoption of better observability tools
* Support application teams in adopting a consistent set of tools, practices and technology to support an agile delivery model, including automation and incremental delivery of software in test and production environments running in the cloud and on premises
* To operate at scale, engage with vendors and service providers to bring best in class industry practices, speed up internal build as well as accelerate companywide adoption of new tools and practices
* Assist and architect where appropriate solutions using containerisation and serverless technologies
* Drive automation for environment management, logging and monitoring
* To fulfil any additional / ad hoc duties as required to meet the needs of the business.

**Experience / Competences**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science
* Over 5\-10 yrs experience in practising and leading DevOps practice in leading Financial or Technology companies
* Demonstrated experience leading and executing transformation programs involving significant uplift of DevOps and SDLC automation capabilities
* Experience delivering measurable process and productivity improvements via DevOps investments and driving a metrics driven practice of continuous improvement
* Intimately familiar with modern DevOps and SRE principles
* Deep and broad experience of AWS Cloud platform and services (Azue or GCP also considered)
* Previous experience in automating and integrating Testing into CI/CD pipelines (unit, integration, smoke testing)
* Previous experience working in development teams using Agile methodologies (e.g. SAFe) and practising Lean Delivery principles
* Knowledge of third\-party automation tools and technologies with relative pros and cons for all stages of SDLC, CI/CD pipelines and observability
* Platforms; Windows Server, Amazon Linux, RHEL, Ubuntu
* Proficiency in at least one of the following scripting languages; Python, GO, PowerShell, Bash, Groovy
* Programming language with a working knowledge in at least one of Java, C\# (.NET Framework/Core), JavaScript (Node.js), Ruby, C\+\+
* Developer tooling; Full stack CI/CD, GitLab, Jenkins, SonarQubeNexus
* Knowledge and working experience of containerising application components including writing DockerFiles and deploying to Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of pipelines as code
* Observability concepts and tooling; Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch

***Band \& Level – Manager, 6***

\#LI\-MID \#LI\-Hybrid \#NIJobs


**Not The Perfect Fit?**

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.


**Company Statement**

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord \- our Employee Network \- is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.


**Location**

UK \- City Quays 3 \- Belfast

jobs.title: Software Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Req ID: 62580
Job Function: Security
Posting Start Date: 15/09/2026
Posting End Date:
Division: UK Business
Job Location: GBR\-Manchester\-New Bailey
Advertised Salary: Competitive with great benefits
Recruiter: Lloyd Hughes
  

Hiring Manager: Benedict Forster
  

Career Grade: D
  

Internal Closing Date: 29th September 2026


Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels/national\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels) . An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.


Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber\-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses. We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
  

You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.


**About the role**
------------------

Our Engineering mantra is “Technical Excellence in Engineering” and we deliver some amazing technical capabilities for our customers which can only happen if we recruit, train and support our people.


This is an exciting opportunity to join one of our software delivery teams, working alongside our customers and partners to work on key customer services.


The team develop and maintain bespoke, highly complex, specialist capabilities that are critical to the success of our customers, who we work very closely with. We work across a wide variety of platforms and technology stacks and we utilise a range of programming languages.


**This job role is based in Manchester. Onsite (Office based 5 days per week). Monday\-Friday 37\.5 hours per week. You will need to be eligible to obtain DV Security Clearance before starting this role. You will need to have lived in the UK for 10\+ years to be eligible.**

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Delivers on the engineering strategy through delivery of high quality, and well\-tested, software solutions, on time and on budget.
* Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work covering technical responsibilities.
* Works closely with customers to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
* Establishes technical objectives, defines technical roadmaps and delegates responsibilities.
* Influences a significant part of own organisation and influences customers/suppliers and industry at a senior management level (e.g. around resourcing of delivery teams and technical direction of work).
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

  

* Agile development
* Programming
* Software testing
* Application development
* Software development lifecycle
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Evidence of creatively applying a wide range of technical and/management principles.
* Performance of highly complex work activities covering technical, financial and quality aspects.
* Object\-oriented programming experience, and supporting technologies, including: C\#, Python, C\+\+, low\-level mobile development (Objective\-C, C\+\+), elastic, ansible, docker, Jenkins, git, MEAN stack.
**Our Package**
---------------

When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market\-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry\-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.


* A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
* Competitive DV market aligned salaries
* Tiered role based DV allowance of up to £5k per annum paid monthly
* World\-class training and development opportunities
* 10% on target bonus
* Equal family leave: receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
* Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
* BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
* New BT Better Workplace working environments at strategic locations across the UK
* Huge range of flexible benefits including an EV salary sacrifice, cycle to work, healthcare, season ticket loan, additional annual leave
* On\-call allowance (Depending on role requirements)
* Access to 100’s of retail discounts including the BT shop
* 24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
* Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes
* 25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
* 2 weeks paid carer’s leave
* Discounted broadband, mobile and TV packages
* Enhanced life assurance of up to ten times base salary


Security is one of the fastest growing parts of our global organisation. We are protecting our networks from more than 6,500 cyber attacks each day, investing over £40m in research each year \- and in employing nearly 3,000 people, we’re also the largest private cyber employer in the UK. With incredible opportunities to learn, develop and grow your skills, we’ll invest in you, nurture your potential and shape your future – whatever your background or experience.
  

  

In today’s world, safe and secure digital connections have never been more vital. You’ll be joining a global company operating at the forefront of the information age: BT employs 90,000 people in 180 countries. With huge scale, we’re capable of achieving great things, striving to be personal, simple, and brilliant for our customers whilst creating an inclusive working environment where people from all backgrounds can succeed. Play your part. Make a difference. We are the Protectors.


A FEW POINTS TO NOTE:


Although these roles are listed as full\-time, if you’re a job share partnership, work reduced hours, or any other way of working flexibly, please still get in touch.


We will also offer reasonable adjustments for the selection process if required, so please do not hesitate to inform us.


DON'T MEET EVERY SINGLE REQUIREMENT?


Studies have shown that women and people who are disabled, LGBTQ\+, neurodiverse or from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification and criteria. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace where everyone can be their best, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement on the Job Description, please apply anyway \- you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles in our wider team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Git Systems
jobs.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  

Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United Kingdom  

Overview:

GitHub is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Git Systems Engineering team, which runs the largest code\-hosting platform in the world, part of our Platform and Infrastructure organization. Our group is responsible for the services that store and serve Git repositories, both directly to users and to other layers in the GitHub software stack. We build the various microservices, protocols, proxies, and control systems that power Git operations at GitHub and operate them at scale.  

Our group is highly distributed and the right candidate will thrive in an environment of asynchronous communication. We expect you to have excellent written communication skills and be able to create working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe.  

This role is focused on wide\-reaching, cross\-team work to improve our git code\-hosting platform. This role will be involved in the design, rollout and support of highly performant, highly scalable, and highly available services to enable the next generation of AI\-driven software development. **P****rior experience solving problems with large\-scale, distributed systems** **is preferred****.****(****i.e.** **Petabytes of storage, millions of objects, low latency, high throughput with millions of QPS)**
Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, test, and ship high\-quality solutions within the team’s service area, with attention to scalability, availability, and maintainability; build deep familiarity with the systems you own and apply best practices to keep code extensible and operable.
* Lead technical discussions for features in the team’s area of responsibility; produce design docs/proposals as needed; and validate approaches through targeted experiments and prototypes, incorporating stakeholder and customer feedback.
* Lead by example by writing clean, defensive, maintainable code and mentoring engineers within the immediate team on implementation details, debugging techniques, and product/service expertise.
* Provide technical leadership in code reviews to ensure changes meet GitHub and team quality standards (correctness, security, reliability, diagnosability, and maintainability), and that code is ready to merge and operate at the expected scale.
* Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to define requirements, identify dependencies, break work into deliverable milestones, and provide estimates and risk/impact tradeoffs to support prioritization and successful delivery.
* Participate in the on\-call rotation for the team’s services; act as a first responder for your area of ownership; troubleshoot complex live\-site issues using logs/telemetry; drive mitigations and safe deployments (including rollback plans); and write postmortems that result in measurable follow\-up improvements.
* Model engineering excellence by improving developer workflows (tooling, automation, and repeatable quality checks), sharing learnings from investigations and incidents, and contributing to a collaborative team culture with strong ownership and inclusive communication.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications*** 6\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
	+ OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
	+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
	+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python
	+ OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
	+ OR equivalent experience.

 **Other Qualifications:*** Ability to meet GitHub, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft, GitHub’s parent company, Cloud Screen upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

 **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience with cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services.
* Understanding of production system monitoring and observability.
* Ability to think critically about both system design and software engineering concepts and blend those perspectives pragmatically based on project needs.
* Demonstrated experience with large\-scale system architecture and design, particularly in cloud\-based environments, with a strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices.
* Experience working closely with product management, design, and other engineering teams to drive cross\-functional projects and deliver high\-quality product.


GitHub Leadership Principles:
**GitHub values**


* Customer\-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive


**Manager fundamentals**


* Model
* Coach
* Care


**Leadership principles**


* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success


Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.  

Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.  

Join us, and let’s change the world, together.  

EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI and Innovation
jobs.description:
Who we're looking for


We're looking for an Applied AI Software Engineer to help build and improve AI\-enabled products used across the organisation. This is a fast\-paced delivery role, ideal for engineers who enjoy working close to business problems, rapid iteration, good engineering practice, and applied AI solutions that deliver real business value.
  

As a member of the team, you’ll contribute to the delivery of Agentic AI systems in applied business contexts. You’ll work directly with internal customers, product owners, business teams and other engineers to turn use cases into safe, reliable and useful software.
  

You should be proficient in Python and modern engineering practices, comfortable contributing across backend and frontend environments, and interested in using AI\-assisted development methods responsibly. Strong collaboration, testing discipline, willingness to learn, and a product mindset are essential.
  

If you're excited by the challenge of building useful AI\-enabled software and learning how agentic systems work in production, we’d love to hear from you.  



  

About Us
  

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.
  

  

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  



The team


The AI and Innovation team is part of the Global Technology division, operating as a centre of excellence for applied AI and agentic systems. We deliver AI\-enabled products and internal tools across multiple areas of the business, helping teams explore, shape and deliver practical AI use cases safely, reliably and efficiently. We work across the full lifecycle from discovery and experimentation through to production use.


What you'll do


* Develop and deliver AI\-enabled features and workflows that solve real business problems, working within agreed product and technical direction.
* Build and maintain production software that integrates with business workflows, data sources, third\-party APIs and LLM services such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
* Implement components of agentic AI solutions using Schroders’ standardised agentic infrastructure platform based on AWS Bedrock AgentCore, including tool integrations, user journeys, guardrails and evaluation approaches.
* Work directly with internal customers and colleagues across product, engineering and business teams to clarify use cases, deliver useful increments, and iterate quickly based on feedback.
* Apply quality and security practices, including automated testing, peer review, secure coding and shift\-left testing.
* Support the evaluation of AI system behaviour in real use, clearly communicating limitations, risks, quality and user impact.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools responsibly to improve speed, quality and learning, while maintaining clear ownership of code quality.
* Engage in continuous improvement through code reviews, automated testing, documentation, evaluation design and metrics\-driven iteration.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need
  

* Strong software engineering background, with Python\-first development experience.
* Experience building, testing and maintaining production software, APIs, integrations or user\-facing features.
* Good understanding of automated testing, code review, CI/CD, debugging and secure coding practices.
* Experience integrating with third\-party APIs, business systems or LLM APIs.
* Comfort working in agile teams, breaking work into deliverable increments, and communicating progress clearly.
* Practical understanding of how to test AI outputs, apply responsible AI controls, and explain model limitations and risks before production use.
The knowledge, experience and qualifications that will help
  

* Experience building applied AI products or features that integrate with LLM API services such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
* Experience using Agentic AI Coding tools to enhance the software delivery process while maintaining high levels of understanding of the resulting code. Using skills, tools and prompting to ensure quality output of those tools.
* Hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-grade agentic or tool\-using AI systems, including orchestration, tool permissions, guardrails, evaluation, human oversight and operational monitoring.
* Experience designing or using evaluations to measure model quality, task completion, safety, regressions and behaviour in multi agent workflows.
* Familiarity with RAG workflows, enterprise data access patterns, vector stores, embedding design, and latency/cost trade\-offs.
* Experience working with business stakeholders to shape requirements, test prototypes and turn feedback into working software.
* Experience working with enterprise controls such as identity, access management, auditability, data classification or approval workflows in software delivery.
* Knowledge of agent interoperability and integration standards such as A2A or MCP, particularly where agents need to interact safely with enterprise tools and systems.
* Active contributor to engineering communities, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
What you'll be like


* A curious technologist who stays up\-to\-date with AI and software trends.
* Open to feedback, willing to ask questions, and keen to learn from more experienced engineers.
* Someone who values quality, security, and solid engineering practices.
* Collaborative communicator, comfortable working with diverse teams across locations and time zones.
* Resilient and positive, able to manage pressure with professionalism.
* Self\-motivated, analytical, and solution\-oriented with a growth mindset.
* Demonstrates integrity, fairness, and respect for all colleagues.

We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. jobs.title: Head of Architecture - Asset Management Platform
jobs.description:
**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking a high\-calibre, hands\-on Head of Architecture to lead the definition and evolution of business architecture across our Asset Management Business.


This role is pivotal in ensuring that enterprise strategy, operating models, and cross\-domain business capabilities are clearly defined, aligned, and translated into scalable platform outcomes.


You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, operating model design, and platform enablement, ensuring coherence across Investment, Client, Group Operations, Data, and Finance business aligned domains.


As a senior leader, you will embed a strong business architecture discipline within a platform\-centric operating model, driving clarity, standardisation, and measurable business value across the organisation.


**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.  



Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  



**The team**

The Asset Management Platform (AMP) is a global technology change and delivery organisation responsible for the platforms that underpin Schroders’ investment, client and operational capabilities across public and private markets


AMP brings together a set of business\-aligned technology platforms—including Client, Investment, Group Operations, Data and Finance—into a single, integrated asset management capability, enabling consistent, scalable and value\-driven outcomes across the firm.


Operating within a platform\-centric model, teams are aligned to business outcomes while leveraging shared enterprise capabilities across architecture, data, engineering and delivery to drive standardisation, reuse, and speed of execution.


**Asset Management Platform – Analysis \& Design**

The Analysis \& Design function is a core enterprise level capability within the Asset Management Platform, accountable for shaping the future direction of the firm's technology and business capabilities.


Operating across all business aligned domains, the team provides leadership in business analysis, architecture, operating model design, strategic analysis and product management, ensuring investment is aligned to business priorities and enterprise outcomes.


Through the definition of common standards, reusable design patterns and platform\-wide governance, the function drives consistency, simplification and scalability, enabling the organisation to accelerate change, optimise cost, and realise the full potential of data, AI and platform\-based operating models.


**Architecture plays a central role in achieving this by:**

* Defining enterprise\-wide capability models and value streams
* Ensuring alignment across platforms and business domains
* Driving standardisation, simplification, and convergence
* Enabling data\- and AI\-driven transformation at scale

The Head of Architecture will provide the structural backbone linking strategy to execution, ensuring that business intent is consistently realised across the platform ecosystem.


**What you’ll do**

* Define and lead the business architecture vision, framework, and standards across the Asset Management Platform
* Establish and maintain enterprise\-aligned capability models, value streams, and operating models
* Ensure traceability from strategy capabilities value streams processes platform enablement
* Translate business and corporate strategy into clear, structured business architecture artefacts and roadmaps
* Enable enterprise\-wide coherence and alignment across platform initiatives
* Define and evolve target operating models across front\-to\-back functions
* Drive simplification, standardisation, and scalability of business processes globally
* Support the transition to platform\-centric and product\-aligned ways of working
* Own the enterprise business capability model aligned to GOP
* Identify capability gaps, overlaps, and optimisation opportunities across domains
* Define and embed value metrics, OKRs, and benefits realisation frameworks
* Ensure alignment of business architecture across multiple platforms and domains
* Partner with platform architects, domain architects, and enterprise architecture
* Act as a bridge between business strategy and platform design/delivery
* Embed data and AI considerations into business architecture design
* Ensure capabilities and processes are structured to leverage advanced analytics and AI insights
* Align with enterprise data strategy, governance, and platform capabilities
* Establish and enforce business architecture governance, standards, and best practices
* Contribute to the broader enterprise architecture and design community
* Promote consistency and quality in artefacts (capabilities, value streams, process maps, etc.)

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Proven experience in a senior Business Architecture leadership role in a complex, global organisation
* Strong understanding of asset management business models across front, middle, and back office
* Experience operating within platform\-led or product\-based operating models
* Deep expertise in: Business capability modelling, Value stream mapping, Operating model design, End\-to\-end process architecture
* Experience aligning business architecture with technology and data platforms
* Strong ability to translate complex strategy into structured, actionable frameworks
* Experience supporting large\-scale, cross\-domain transformation programmes
* Focus on value delivery, outcomes, and measurable impact
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across business and technology
* Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts
* Experience working across global, matrixed environments
* Technology \& Platform Awareness
* Strong appreciation of modern technology concepts including Platform architectures, Data ecosystems, API and integration models
* Ability to ensure business intent is effectively realised in platform design and delivery

**What you’ll be like**

The successful candidate will be a strategic and outcome‑driven architect, able to connect business priorities with clear, scalable technology direction. They will combine strong vision with pragmatism—defining long‑term platform strategy while making practical decisions that enable delivery at pace. With deep technical credibility, they will engage confidently across architecture, engineering and delivery teams, shaping solutions that are robust, aligned to enterprise standards and focused on delivering tangible business value.  



They will operate as a collaborative and influential leader within a complex, global environment, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders. A strong advocate of simplification, standardisation and reuse, they will actively reduce complexity and drive convergence across the platform. Clear in their communication and accountable in their approach, they will take ownership for the platform’s evolution, contribute to the wider architecture community, and continuously apply emerging technologies—particularly data and AI—to enhance investment capabilities and outcomes.  



**We recognise potential, whoever you are**

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.  



We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer

jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Principal Software Engineer** to shape the architecture and delivery of our modern, AWS\-native platform powering underwriting intelligence, GenAI\-driven analysis, and high\-volume content processing.


Working across **Python, .NET, PostgreSQL/Aurora, OpenSearch, and LangGraph\-based services** , you will own technical direction, system quality, scalability, and reliability across the platform. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibility, including **setting engineering standards, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and coordinating across product and platform teams** .


  
* **Shape platform architecture** across ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, and AI\-powered services, ensuring scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
* **Own end\-to\-end technical delivery** of AWS Batch content pipelines, Lambda\-based workflows, and .NET 8 REST/GraphQL APIs.
* Drive architecture decisions around **Aurora PostgreSQL, graph\-based data models, and OpenSearch** to support GenAI retrieval and high\-volume workloads.
* Define and champion **engineering, data quality, testing, and observability standards** across platforms including Pentaho, ThoughtSpot, CloudWatch, and Splunk.
* Partner with ML and Product Engineering teams to ensure **LangGraph\-based RAG pipelines** have reliable, current, and well\-structured data and service layers.
* Shape **LLM evaluation and prompt data pipelines** , including ground\-truth and synthetic datasets for testing and model quality.
* Apply senior technical judgment to **review and validate AI\-assisted engineering output** before production deployment.
* Lead architecture discussions through **technical briefs, RFCs, design reviews, and documented trade\-offs** .
* Define testing, rollout, monitoring, and rollback strategies for critical platform changes.
* Lead **production incident reviews and postmortems** , driving actions that improve reliability and operational resilience.
* Establish and evolve **engineering standards and best practices** , reinforcing them through code reviews and practical examples.
* **Mentor engineers** on software architecture, data engineering, design patterns, and responsible AI\-assisted development.
* Coordinate technical dependencies across product squads, ensuring **clear interfaces, effective collaboration, and smooth delivery** .
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders.

  
* **Extensive software engineering experience** , with a proven track record of building and operating production systems and data pipelines at scale.
* Strong **software architecture and system design** expertise, with experience making and documenting complex technical trade\-offs.
* Advanced experience with **.NET / C\#** , including production services and APIs using REST and GraphQL.
* Deep hands\-on experience with **AWS** , including S3, Batch, Lambda, SNS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, EKS, and CloudWatch.
* Strong **SQL and PostgreSQL** expertise, including schema design, query optimization, and graph\-based data modelling.
* Experience designing **distributed, scalable, and fault\-tolerant systems** , with robust observability, recovery, and rollback strategies.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed services, using **logs, metrics, and traces** with tools such as Splunk and CloudWatch.

* Experience with **OpenSearch or vector search** technologies for RAG applications.

jobs.description:

This role is primarily a software engineering position — you will design, build, and own services and pipelines in Python and .NET — with data engineering as a core domain rather than the whole job. You'll also work alongside AI coding agents to accelerate delivery, and act as a quality gate for agent\-generated code.

* Develop and integrate **REST and GraphQL APIs with .NET 8** , including clear data contracts and automated testing.
* Build **Python\-based data pipelines on AWS Batch** for data ingestion, transformation, and loading into Aurora PostgreSQL.
* Develop document parsing and transformation workflows using **Pandas, BeautifulSoup, and XML/HTML tools** .
* Leverage **AI coding tools and LLMs** (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, AWS Kiro) to accelerate development while ensuring code quality, security, and maintainability.
* Design and operate **AWS\-based workflows** using services such as S3, Batch, Lambda, SNS, EKS, and CloudWatch.

They design systems that help industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice, and continuously evolve our platform using cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

* Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, Grafana, or equivalent APM and logging tools

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Python/Azure/Fabric/Purview)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.  

  

Your Skills And Experiences  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.
##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues


Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories


##### **Skills**


Must have


PowerShell,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Python,


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Fabric,


AI Landing zones,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated.


##### **Other**


Languages


English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority


Senior


  
Remote Poland, Poland

* Samodzielne prowadzenie zadań \- od rozpoznania problemu, przez zaprojektowanie i implementację, aż po wdrożenie.Testowanie nowych funkcji i narzędzi wspólnie z pracownikami oraz rozwijanie ich na podstawie informacji zwrotnych.

* Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona.

* Umiejętność projektowania i wdrażania nowych funkcjonalności.
* Gotowość do poznawania pracy różnych działów i bezpośredniej rozmowy z pracownikami.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
jobs.description:
We are an entertainment and content creation company powered by technology and pushing the boundaries of innovation and creativity to create world\-leading gaming content.


An ASX Listed company, headquartered in Sydney, Australia, we’ve grown from humble beginnings to boast more than 8,000 employees across 20 locations around the world, united by the common mission to *Bring Joy to Life Through the Power of Play*. Through our three operating units: Aristocrat Gaming, Product Madness, and Aristocrat Interactive (online RMG), we provide world\-leading mobile and casino games which entertain millions of players across the globe every day.


Connection and integrity are at the heart of everything we do. We put the wellbeing of our people first by giving employees the tools they need to grow, be inspired, and be the best they can be every day. We also strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay and set new standards in company governance and sustainability to support a better, brighter future – full of play.

**Summary**
-----------


We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join a multi\-functional agile team committed to building the core architecture and infrastructure of our next\-generation platform.


This is not just another feature team role. You will be chipping in to the foundation of a scalable, cloud\-ready system, designed to operate across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.


You’ll work in a modern engineering ecosystem, using technologies such as .NET Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, and Ably, while actively shaping how the system evolves toward a fully distributed microservices architecture.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Designing and developing scalable microservices from the ground up
* Contributing to the evolution of a cloud\-native, platform\-independent system
* Integrating legacy components into modern architecture
* Reverse\-engineering and gradually migrating monolithic parts into microservices
* Writing clean, maintainable code with strong focus on quality and testability (TDD)
* Participating in code reviews and driving engineering guidelines
* Collaborating closely with multi\-functional teams across product, QA, and DevOps

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years of experience in backend development using .NET / .NET Core
* Hands\-on experience building large\-scale web\-based systems
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture
* Strong knowledge of relational databases
* Analytical attitude with strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work independently while being a reliable teammate
* Continuous learning approach and adaptability to new technologies
* Good written and verbal English communication skills
* Familiarity with AI agents and workflows

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with TDD and automated testing approaches
* Understanding of event\-driven architecture (Kafka, pub/sub patterns)
* Experience with database development and optimization

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================


We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.  

  



Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.  

  



Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Mjukvaruingenjör - C#.NET ﻿
jobs.description:
*Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.*

### **Din roll**


Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team inom delprojektet Digital Map Generating System (DMGS) / Geodata inom JAS Gripen i rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare.

  

Vi är en central resurs som har expertis inom GIS, geodata och aeronautisk information. Geodata är en viktig del av de flesta av Saabs produkter och tjänster inom flyg, försvar och säkerhet. DMGS är ett egenutvecklat verktyg baserat på ESRI ArcMap för att behandla, kvalitetssäkra och producera Geodata till Gripen samt dess stöd\- och träningssystem.

  

I rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare ingår t.ex. uppgifter som att arbeta fram kreativa lösningar kring överenskommen kravbild tillsammans med angränsande system. Planering, testning och möjligheten att kommunicera utvecklad funktion till intressenter kan också vara en del av arbetet.


Under funktionsutvecklingen kommer du samtidigt att få lära dig om hur vårt data och system kravställs, utvecklas, testas och distribueras; både i form av geografiska data till flygplan, till 3D\-omvärldar för Gripens simulatorer samt till andra intressanta system.

  

Teamet består idag av roller som uppdragsledare, systemingenjörer och mjukvaruutvecklare och kännetecknas av en trevlig stämning och en god kultur av att hjälpa och lära av varandra.


Det finns en stor möjlighet till att anpassa dagarna med varierade arbetsuppgifter och även möjligheter att få delta på konferenser som sker utomlands.

  

Din närmsta chef är utbildad coach och om du brinner för personlig utveckling finns det stora möjligheter. Du erbjuds möjligheten att genomföra både interna och externa utbildningar.

### **Din profil**

* Kunskap inom C\#.NET; gärna även inom WPF, Async Await och TPL.
* Du har erfarenhet kring AI i kombination med programmering
* Kunskap att se helheten och förstå hur olika delar av ett system interagerar. Detta är kritiskt för att designa skalbara och underhållbara system.
* Förmågan att identifiera, analysera och lösa komplexa problem.
* Förmågan att kommunicera tekniska koncept på ett sätt som är förståeligt för både tekniska och icke\-tekniska teammedlemmar. Detta inkluderar dokumentation och presentationer.
* Förmågan att säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Inkluderar även testning, säkerhet och prestandaoptimering.
* Förmågan att arbeta effektivt i ett team och har en bra kommunikativ approach
* Applikationer: MS Visual Studio, ESRI ArcMap, ESRI ArcGIS Pro


Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

### **Vad blir du en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars\- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

jobs.title: Backend Developer till Synsams Digital Business-team
jobs.description:
Nu söker vi på Synsam en Backend Developer som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår digitala plattform och skapa stabila lösningar som gör skillnad för både verksamheten och våra kunder. Vi söker dig som tar stort eget ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och gärna bidrar med initiativ, kunskap och idéer som utvecklar både våra lösningar och vårt sätt att arbeta.


Hos oss blir du en viktig del av Synsams fortsatta digitala utveckling och vår ambition att vara det ledande och mest hållbara livsstilsföretaget inom optik och ögonhälsa. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar i en miljö där innovation, utveckling och en riktigt bra digital kundupplevelse står i fokus. Är du nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att bygga smarta och hållbara lösningar? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

**Om tjänsten**


Som Backend Developer blir du en del av vårt Digital Business\-team, där du tillsammans med Team Lead och kollegor inom fullstack, backend, frontend och test driver utvecklingen av Synsams e\-handelsplattform. Du arbetar med .NET, C\# och Visual Basic och är med och vidareutvecklar stabila lösningar som är en viktig del av våra kunders digitala upplevelse.


Hos oss är ensam inte stark! Du blir en del av ett framåtsträvande och sammansvetsat tvärfunktionellt team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och lär av varandra. Din närmaste chef, Pasha Ayani, arbetar även som Team Lead och tillsammans med resten av teamet driver ni utvecklingen framåt. Det här är ett team som välkomnar nya idéer, vågar testa alternativa vägar och tillsammans hittar lösningar som skapar värde för både Synsam och våra kunder.

**Ditt arbete kommer bland annat innebära:**

* Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara backend\-lösningar.
* Implementera och förvalta integrationer mot externa system.
* Delta i teknisk planering och scoping av initiativ.
* Säkerställa prestanda, säkerhet och stabilitet i våra tjänster.
* Sätta och upprätthålla kodstandarder, samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar i teamets arbetsmetoder.
* Stötta teamet vid komplexa tekniska utmaningar.
* Utforska och implementera nya teknologier och verktyg för att förbättra våra processer.

**Profil**


Vi söker dig som är en erfaren backendutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa komplexa problem och bygga stabila och skalbara lösningar. Du är tekniskt nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och fokus på att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.


Du trivs i ett prestigelöst och tvärfunktionellt team där man samarbetar nära och gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke\-tekniska kollegor och bidrar gärna till att utveckla såväl våra tekniska lösningar som teamets arbetssätt.

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**

* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av backend\-utveckling.
* Stark kunskap inom .NET och C\#.
* Erfarenhet av databaser, databasdesign och optimering i MSSQL.
* Erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure, samt CI/CD.
* Vana av agila arbetsmetoder och att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team.
* Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande:** Erfarenhet av frontend, eventbaserad design och API\-integrationer.

**Några ord från Pasha Ayani, Team Lead.**

*"Det bästa med att arbeta på Synsam är kombinationen av modern teknik, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en del av ett kompetent och prestigelöst team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och tillsammans utvecklar den digitala kundupplevelsen. När jag inte jobbar tränar jag brasiliansk jiu\-jitsu, lagar mat och umgås med familj och vänner, en bra balans som jag tycker är viktig även i arbetslivet."*

**Har vi väckt ditt intresse?**  

Vad roligt! Klicka på länken nedan och skicka in din ansökan redan idag! I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden**

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?


At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We’re looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C\# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C\# and React/TypeScript. You’ll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.


We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.


At Appgate, you’ll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.


At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.


Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We’re also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.


We're also developing AI\-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

 **Requirements** **Your role in the Core team**


The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.


The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.


**This is a fullstack role:** your work will span the client, its C\# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You’ll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate \| Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.


**You’ll help us:**

* Develop features for the Appgate client, using C\#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
* Develop features for the Java REST backend.
* Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
* Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
* Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.

**What you bring**

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You’re comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.


**We’re looking for:**

• Strong professional experience with C\#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.


• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.


• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.


* Good communication skills in English.

 **Benefits**  

Build something, you can put your name to If you’re looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we’d like to hear from you.


Join Appgate’s Core team and help shape what comes next.

jobs.title: Tech Advisor-Software Dev
jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


**Job Duties**
--------------


**About Landmark**

  

  

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud\-native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on\-premises solutions.
  

  

**About the Role**  



  

You are a senior developer with a designer's eye and in\-depth knowledge of computer graphics. You shape 3D engineering applications and digital twins, connecting back\-end data processing with real\-time rendering and 3D user experience (UX) design. Drawing on extensive experience with professional CAD and 3D software, you use established interaction patterns to make navigation, selection, and manipulation efficient, helping engineers stay oriented in complex models. You work across the full stack with Unity, WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js, and modern web frameworks, taking solutions from prototypes through to production.  

  



**What You Will Do**


* Own the architecture and technical direction of the 3D component, working closely with product management and domain specialists.
* Design and build 3D and extended reality (XR) interactions for inspection, measurement, well planning, and collaboration.
* Develop processing pipelines, shaders, and reusable tools. Improve memory use, efficiency, and responsiveness with large datasets.
* Prepare and integrate CAD models, geospatial and subsurface data, point clouds, and volumetric datasets for accurate real\-time visualization.
* Lead design and code reviews, strengthen testing and debugging tools, and maintain the code through successive releases.

Evaluate and integrate AI where it improves engineering workflows, with attention to reliability, privacy, and cost.  
* 
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Masters’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* 20 or more years of wide\-ranging experience across software development, computer graphics, and design
* Deep proficiency in Unity and C\#, with experience owning and improving a substantial real\-time 3D codebase
* In\-depth knowledge of rendering, shading, geometry, and performance optimization, supported by hands\-on 3D production experience
* Experience designing and implementing 3D and XR interactions, from user research and prototypes to testing with domain users
* Strong aesthetic judgment, including composition, lighting, materials, and visual hierarchy, applied to clear, usable engineering tools
* Experience converting and optimizing large CAD and geospatial datasets, including coordinate systems, terrain, and point clouds
* Communication skills sharp enough to explain a technical trade\-off to a product manager and a design choice to a junior engineer with equal clarity
* Practical knowledge of AI tools and model integration, including the capabilities and limitations of hosted and local models

**Preferred**


* Experience with WebGL, Three.js or Babylon.js, TypeScript, and full\-stack development with automated delivery using Git and Docker
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation
* Familiarity with geospatial coordinate systems and transformations, georeferencing, point clouds, and volumetric data such as voxel grids
* Experience with industrial digital twins, subsurface visualization, or collaborative VR tools.

Experience contributing to open\-source projects, or integrating open\-source components at scale.  
* 

**How You Work**


The senior engineer who succeeds in this role thinks at the level of the system, not only the feature. You work end to end, understanding how back\-end data, software architecture, real\-time graphics, and user interaction affect one another. You stay hands\-on from scoping through implementation and delivery. You explain technical choices clearly to developers, designers, domain experts, Product Management, and leadership, with the detail each needs to make a decision.

  

  

You bring the experience to know when a technical decision will cost the team later, the credibility to say so clearly, and the follow\-through to drive it toward a better outcome. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and pragmatic enough to ship when the solution is sound, even if it is not perfect. You do not wait for someone to identify what needs fixing. You see it, own it, and drive it to resolution.
  

You stay technically sharp because you are genuinely curious, and you bring what you learn back to the team. You invest in the people around you because you understand that your long\-term contribution depends on the quality of the team, not only the quality of your own code.  

  



**Why Landmark**


We build small, high\-ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. Here you have the autonomy to make real technical decisions, peers strong enough to challenge you, and problems deep enough to be worth solving well. We offer competitive compensation including bonus and long\-term incentive programs, a strong career path, and a role where your technical judgment shapes what gets built.  

  



Minimum Qualifications: Minimum qualifications may be acquired through technical schools or equivalent related experience. Candidates having qualifications that exceed the minimum job requirements will receive consideration for higher level roles given (1\) their experience, (2\) additional job requirements, and/or (3\) business needs. Depending on education, experience, and skill level, a variety of job opportunities might be available from the Software Engineer \- Snr
